_readme: Tasks for projexlight_create_tasks_bulk. Each entry carries feature_temp_id and epic_temp_id which MUST be substituted for the real UUIDs returned by projexlight_import_full before submitting. sprint_id is fixed. See README.md in this folder for the exact procedure.
_substitution: Replace feature_temp_id -> feature_id and epic_temp_id -> epic_id using the id_mapping returned by the import step, then submit in batches of 12-14 to stay under the MCP response size limit.

tasks.title: [sdk-source-record][DB] Schema, enums and immutability triggers
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-source-record/src/db/migrations. Ordered idempotent Postgres migrations for source_record, source_assertion, source_rights_attestation and id_crosswalk. Create the four ENUM types (origin_class 8 values, trust_state 5 values, assertion_status 4 values, evidence_kind). Indexes on (tenant_id, trust_state), (subject_ref, attribute), (tenant_id, origin_class); UNIQUE(tenant_id, external_system, external_id) on crosswalks. A BEFORE UPDATE trigger rejects any change to raw_evidence or origin_class after insert. Exported as runMigrations() invoked at Fastify boot only — never on module import, never inside data-access code.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations are additive, IF NOT EXISTS and safe to re-run on every boot
raw_evidence and origin_class are immutable after insert, enforced by trigger
All four enums exist as Postgres ENUM types
Crosswalk uniqueness is enforced per tenant and external system

tasks.title: [sdk-source-record][SERVICE] Trust-ladder capture, normalize and promote
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-source-record/src/services/sourceRecordService.ts. Create with fingerprint dedupe; normalize P0->P1 delegating to sdk-parsing POST /api/parsing/contact/extract; promote P1->P2->P3->P4 with per-transition evidence requirements. Promotion to P4_DIRECT REQUIRES a first-party evidence reference and returns a typed 422 naming the missing evidence otherwise. Absent or unrecognised origin_class routes the record to UNKNOWN_QUARANTINED rather than defaulting. Every transition appends exactly one sdk-audit entry (POST /api/audit/append) carrying actor, purpose, decision reference and causation id.
acceptance_criteria: P4 promotion without first-party evidence is rejected with a typed error
Unknown origin class quarantines rather than defaulting
Each transition appends exactly one audit entry
Fingerprint dedupe prevents a duplicate source record on retry

tasks.title: [sdk-source-record][SERVICE] Bitemporal assertion write and supersede
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-source-record/src/services/assertionService.ts. Write assertions with origin class, confidence, effective_from/effective_to and retrieved_at. Supersede sets status SUPERSEDED and superseded_by on the prior row — never UPDATE of the value and never DELETE. Query by subject_ref and attribute returns ALL coexisting assertions so conflicting source values are visible rather than collapsed. PII values are envelope-encrypted through sdk-vault POST /api/vault/encrypt before persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Superseding retains the prior row with its original value and dates
Query returns all coexisting assertions, not just the survivor
PII assertion values are encrypted at rest via sdk-vault
No code path issues UPDATE or DELETE against an assertion value

tasks.title: [sdk-source-record][SERVICE] Source-rights attestation and permitted-use check
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-source-record/src/services/attestationService.ts. Sign an attestation with the caller's platform principal over the source fingerprint, mapping version and permitted-use set, recording jurisdiction, licence reference, collection period and an evidence blob reference stored via sdk-evidence POST /api/evidence/capture. REJECT when the evidence blob is absent and origin_class is LICENSED_THIRD_PARTY or PARTNER_PROVIDED. Expose checkPermittedUse(subject_ref, purpose) so a downstream consumer can refuse a purpose the source rights do not cover.
acceptance_criteria: Third-party and partner origins require an evidence blob to attest
Signature covers fingerprint, mapping version and permitted uses
checkPermittedUse refuses a purpose outside the attested set
Attestation is immutable once signed

A structured address proposes a place entity plus a relationship assertion, never a column on the person record. Composes sdk-ai-gateway POST /api/ai-gateway/complete with redaction and budget.
acceptance_criteria: Every suggestion carries a confidence and a reason string
No suggestion is auto-applied without explicit confirmation
Address maps to a place plus relationship, never a person column

tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-import/src/services. commitService: acquire the run lock, verify the attestation is signed, write every row through sdk-ingest POST /api/ingest/:entity/batch keyed on run_id + row fingerprint, land each row via sdk-source-record, apply the chosen identity strategy per match band, create related entities and relationship assertions via sdk-rebac, apply consent and suppression imports through sdk-consent and sdk-deliverability WITHOUT ever fabricating a receipt from a blank or generic field, write lineage per entity and emit correlated events. rollbackService reverses every lineage row, permitted only inside the deadline and only when no downstream governed action has touched an affected entity — otherwise a typed 409 naming the blocker.
acceptance_criteria: Interrupted commit retried yields an identical entity set with no duplicates
Rollback after a downstream governed action returns 409 naming the blocker
Blank or generic fields never produce a consent receipt
Every created entity has exactly one lineage row

tasks.title: [sdk-sla][DB+SERVICE] Business calendar and business-minute arithmetic
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-sla. Migration for business_calendar (named IANA timezone — NEVER a fixed UTC offset — working_windows JSONB, late_coverage_extension_minutes, weekend_rule, holiday_dates DATE[]). calendarService implements business-minute arithmetic across working windows, holidays, weekends and the late-coverage extension: the function that makes a signal arriving one minute before close due thirty minutes later inside the extension rather than deferring. Property-based tests cover DST transitions in both directions, holiday boundaries, year boundaries and windows spanning midnight.
acceptance_criteria: Timezone stored as a named IANA zone
Business-minute arithmetic correct across both DST transitions
Late-coverage extension applied correctly at the window edge

acceptance_criteria: Clock start time survives merge, reassignment and backup takeover
Satisfy rejects evidence not meeting the policy contract

Rung actions compose sdk-notification for the audience, sdk-assignment for auto-reassign, sdk-coverage GET /api/coverage/on-call/current for the escalation audience, and sdk-incident when a breach is flagged systemic.

Each rung resolves its audience through sdk-coverage at fire time
Rung failures are retried without re-firing already-fired rungs

Table-driven tests prove a persona on PTO, inside a meeting block, outside their schedule, or at capacity is NEVER returned, across every combination. Consumed by sdk-assignment step 4 and sdk-sla late-coverage resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Never returns an unavailable or at-capacity persona across all combinations
Returns current load and remaining headroom per persona
Evaluates in the persona's own timezone
Sub-50ms for a 500-persona tenant

acceptance_criteria: Current load computed live rather than from a stale counter
Freeze threshold configurable per band
On-call resolution returns the correct tier for any instant

REQUEST_ONLY roles are blocked until approval is granted

tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-conversation. Ordering is by occurred_at not arrival time so out-of-order provider delivery still renders correctly. INTERNAL_NOTE is structurally distinct so it can never be dispatched to a customer.
acceptance_criteria: Out-of-order provider events render chronologically correct
Internal notes cannot be dispatched through any send path
Existing session and message APIs remain compatible
Thread carries purpose and eligibility snapshot

tasks.title: [sdk-conversation][SERVICE] Reply detection and outbound linkage
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-conversation/src/services. Bind an inbound reply to its originating outbound message across channels using provider message ids, email thread headers and channel heuristics. Emit a domain event on linkage so consumers can pause automation and create an owner task without polling.
acceptance_criteria: Inbound replies link to their originating outbound message
A domain event is emitted on linkage
Linkage works across email, SMS and social DM
Unmatched inbound messages are retained and flagged rather than dropped

tasks.title: [sdk-conversation][API] Compose guardrails and routes
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-conversation/src/server. composeGuardrailService returns allow|review|deny per channel with an ORDERED human-readable reason list, delegating decision inputs to a caller-supplied resolver so the SDK stays vertical-neutral and carries no consent or policy logic of its own. Routes: POST /api/conversations/threads, POST /api/conversations/messages, GET /api/conversations/inbox, GET /api/conversations/threads/:id, POST /api/conversations/compose-guardrail.
acceptance_criteria: Guardrail returns an ordered reason list, never a bare boolean
Decision inputs come from a caller-supplied resolver
No consent or policy logic embedded in the SDK
Inbox supports filtering by unread, awaiting reply and channel

tasks.title: [sdk-parsing][SERVICE] Contact extraction schemas and backends
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-parsing/src/services. Register extraction schemas and backends in the existing parseOrchestrator and schemaResolver for smart-paste blocks, email signatures (multi-handle plus organization candidate), business-card OCR, vCard single and multi, mobile selected contacts, browser-selection text and voice-note transcripts. Every backend returns PROPOSALS with per-field confidence and an evidence span into the raw input. The local deterministic parser always runs first; the LLM adjunct via sdk-ai-gateway is invoked only when required fields remain unresolved AND the caller opted in. Schemas resolve tenant-first with platform fallback via sdk-taxonomy GET /api/taxonomy/extraction-schemas. Routes: POST /api/parsing/contact/extract, POST /api/parsing/contact/extract-batch, GET /api/parsing/contact/schemas.
acceptance_criteria: Local parser runs before any LLM call and the LLM is opt-in
Every proposed field carries confidence and an evidence span
Extraction never fabricates a field absent from the input
Schemas resolve tenant-first with platform fallback

tasks.title: [sdk-projection][SERVICE] Survivorship rules and explained projection
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-projection/src/services. survivorshipRuleService: per-attribute ordered rules weighting origin_class, confidence, recency and verification state, tenant-configurable with a platform default. explainedProjectionService returns the SURVIVING value per attribute PLUS every losing assertion with a CONCRETE reason it lost — never a bare status word. Routes: PUT and GET /api/projection/survivorship-rules, GET /api/projection/subject/:subject_ref/explained.
acceptance_criteria: Every losing assertion carries a concrete reason string
Rules are tenant-configurable with a platform default
Losing assertions remain fully queryable
Explained view is stable for identical inputs

tasks.title: [sdk-projection][SERVICE] Deterministic replay on retract and supersede
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-projection/src/services. replayService rebuilds a subject's projection from the assertion event log rather than patching it, triggered when an identity link is retracted or an assertion is superseded. Replaying the same subject twice yields byte-identical projections. Replay evidence is appended to sdk-audit. Route: POST /api/projection/replay.
acceptance_criteria: Replay is deterministic and idempotent
Retraction triggers automatic replay of affected subjects
Replay evidence appended to the audit chain
Replay of a 10k-assertion subject completes within the request budget

tasks.title: [sdk-notification][SERVICE] Frequency caps and no-answer dedup window
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-notification/src/services. Add per-purpose channel decision inputs, a frequency_cap (max automated sends per channel per day, tenant-configurable) and a configurable no_answer_dedup_window so a retry inside the window never produces a duplicate burst. Existing quiet-hours, sms-consent STOP/HELP, delivery-receipt and provider endpoints are reused UNCHANGED. Additive only — a regression suite proves every existing notification endpoint is unaffected.
acceptance_criteria: Frequency cap and dedup window are tenant-configurable
A retry inside the dedup window produces no duplicate send
All existing notification endpoints pass unchanged
Caps are evaluated per channel and per purpose

tasks.title: [sdk-rebac][SERVICE] Bitemporal contextual-role relationships
tasks.description: REPO: packages/sdk-rebac/src/services. Extend PUT /api/relationships/:relationship_id/scope to CLOSE a relationship by setting valid_to rather than deleting it, keeping it visible in provenance. Evidence references are required for CONFIRMED and DOCUMENTED trust states.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple concurrent roles per pair with independent trust and validity
Closing sets valid_to and never deletes the row
Evidence required for CONFIRMED and DOCUMENTED states
Existing relationship and role-assignment endpoints unchanged

tasks.title: [sdk-lead-scoring][SERVICE] B2B firmographic and intent feature families

No API surface change required

tasks.title: [sdk-connectors][BACKEND] Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and Google lead-form adapters

tasks.title: [platform][TEST] Cross-SDK composition integration suite
tasks.description: REPO: ProjexCloud tests. Prove the new SDKs compose: (1) capture a source record, normalize via sdk-parsing, promote through the ladder, verify both records survive a link and the explained projection names the survivor and the reason; (2) run a full import through dry-run, commit, lineage verification and rollback; (3) start an SLA clock on a subject, verify the ladder fires correctly across a working-window boundary and that a backup takeover preserves the timestamp; (4) request a capability from a REQUEST_ONLY role, verify it blocks until approved then settles to zero on no-match; (5) verify the audit chain is unbroken across the entire composed flow.
acceptance_criteria: All five composition flows pass end to end
Audit chain verifies unbroken across the composed flow
Every mutating call proven idempotent by replay
Suite runs in CI against a fresh self-provisioned environment
